extracted.name: Molasses Cake Bars
extracted.description: These cake bars are good to enjoy with tea, milk or coffee. The coffee, cinnamon and the cloves flavor are tempting😋
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup light brown sugar or granulated sugar (I use brown sugar)
instruction_lines: Sift together the dry ingredients (all porpuse flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, ground cloves and cinnamon, instant coffee powder).
Stir in the dry ingredients mixture into creamed mixture. Mix well.
Pour into greased pan. Bake for 35 minutes.
While the cake is stil warm, dust with confectioners’ sugar. Let it cool for 10 minutes. Cut into 16 squares.
